# Selling for a note: how much tax do you owe each year, and what does spreading it save?

> Free installment sale tax calculator: selling a business, rental or land for a note? See the gain taxed each year, the depreciation recapture due up front, the tax saved by spreading it and what the interest earns after tax. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
